URLSimilarityIndex: legitimate ALL exactly 100.0 (std 0, n=134850); phishing mean 49.6, only 786/100945 (0.78%) >=99.9. Single depth-1 stump at 98.44 gives val_acc 0.9968. Per paper, USI is Phase-1 detector (block if 80<=USI<100) for visual-similarity attacks (homograph/punycode etc). Construction requires comparing URL against a reference (likely legitimate/whitelist or intra-corpus similarity) and HTML/crawled context, i.e. NOT computable from the URL string alone at inference. Even if formula does not literally take the label as input, the empirical distribution (constant 100 for one class) makes it a near-perfect class proxy: direct label leakage in effect, must be excluded from deployable sets (done in NO_SUSPECT_DERIVED).
TLDLegitimateProb: P(TLD|legitimate) estimated from corpus label distribution (legit median 0.5229=max, phish median 0.018). Direct corpus/label-dependent -> leakage.
URLCharProb: char probability under legitimate corpus (legit mean 0.060 vs phish 0.050). Corpus-dependent -> leakage.
DomainTitleMatchScore/URLTitleMatchScore: require fetched HTML Title + matching; legit median 100 vs phish median 0. Webpage-derived, unavailable from URL alone, and confounded by homepage-only legit sampling (homepage title matches domain). Collection-bias-amplified, REVIEW_REQUIRED; excluded from strict sets.
IsHTTPS/has_www/path_present/query_present/URLLength: URL-derived but sampling artifact (legit 100% https, 100% www, 0% paths/queries; phish 49% https, 42% www, 27% paths, 6% queries). Collection bias, not direct formula leakage, but still inflates URL-only accuracy. Kept in STRICT, removed in STRICT_NO_COLLECTION_CUES.
